_meta.note: 一個故事一個檔。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

Ruins of Detlas#001.src: You read an entry in the worn journal...
Ruins of Detlas#001.dst: {c1}ぼろぼろの日誌の一節を読んだ…{/}
Ruins of Detlas#001.note: {c1}You read an entry in the worn journal...{/}

Ruins of Detlas#002.src: A stranger came into town today all the way from {p}. {p} of all places! What do the folk there want with us in this small town?
Ruins of Detlas#002.dst: {c1}今日、はるばる {p} から見知らぬ人が町にやって来た。よりによって {p} から！あそこの人が、こんな小さな町に何の用だろう？{/}
Ruins of Detlas#002.note: {c1}A stranger came into town today all the way from {p}. {p} of all places! What do the folk there want with us in this small town?{/}

Ruins of Detlas#003.src: It's nothing but farmland for as far as the eye can see around here. I want some excitement! I want to go to {p} and see the castle there!
Ruins of Detlas#003.dst: {c1}このあたりは見渡す限り畑ばかり。刺激が欲しい！{p} に行ってお城を見てみたい！{/}
Ruins of Detlas#003.note: {c1}It's nothing but farmland for as far as the eye can see around here. I want some excitement! I want to go to {p} and see the castle there!{/}

Ruins of Detlas#004.src: Then again, the roads are more dangerous now than they ever have been. If rumors are to be trusted, you can't step three feet out of town without running into an undead
Ruins of Detlas#004.dst: {c1}とはいえ、今の道路はかつてないほど危険だ。噂が本当なら、町から3フィートも出れば、必ずアンデッドに遭遇してしまう。{/}
Ruins of Detlas#004.note: {c1}Then again, the roads are more dangerous now than they ever have been. If rumors are to be trusted, you can't step three feet out of town without running into an undead{/}

Ruins of Detlas#005.src: Who knows, maybe this'll all blow over soon...
Ruins of Detlas#005.dst: {c1}まあ、こんなことすぐに収まるかもしれないし…{/}
Ruins of Detlas#005.note: {c1}Who knows, maybe this'll all blow over soon...{/}

Ruins of Detlas#006.src: That trader from {p} was saying some disturbing things the other day.
Ruins of Detlas#006.dst: {c1}先日、{p}のトレーダーが、ちょっと気掛かりなことを言っていた。{/}
Ruins of Detlas#006.note: {c1}That trader from {p} was saying some disturbing things the other day.{/}

Ruins of Detlas#007.src: He mentioned that the undead attacks are growing more frequent all over Wynn. Even {p} is straining under the pressure.
Ruins of Detlas#007.dst: {c1}彼は、 Wynn 全域でアンデッドによる襲撃がますます頻繁になっていると述べた。{p}でさえ、その圧力に耐えかねている。{/}
Ruins of Detlas#007.note: {c1}He mentioned that the undead attacks are growing more frequent all over Wynn. Even {p} is straining under the pressure.{/}

Ruins of Detlas#008.src: {p} has managed to avoid the worst of the scourge. But how much longer will our luck last?
Ruins of Detlas#008.dst: {c1}{p}は、この災厄の最悪の事態をなんとか免れてきた。しかし、この幸運はあとどれくらい続くのだろうか？{/}
Ruins of Detlas#008.note: {c1}{p} has managed to avoid the worst of the scourge. But how much longer will our luck last?{/}

Ruins of Detlas#009.src: It's been unusually quiet these past few days. I don't like it. Even for a small town such as {p}, there is such a thing as being too quiet.
Ruins of Detlas#009.dst: {c1}ここ数日、異様に静かだ。この感じは好きじゃない。{p}のような小さな町であっても、静かすぎるというのはあるものだ。{/}
Ruins of Detlas#009.note: {c1}It's been unusually quiet these past few days. I don't like it. Even for a small town such as {p}, there is such a thing as being too quiet.{/}

Ruins of Detlas#010.src: I fear the rumors of the increasing undead roaming the lands. What's worse, there are other rumors saying that they are being led by a human.
Ruins of Detlas#010.dst: {c1}この地を徘徊するアンデッドが増えているという噂が気にかかる。さらに悪いことに、彼らを率いているのは人間だという噂もある。{/}
Ruins of Detlas#010.note: {c1}I fear the rumors of the increasing undead roaming the lands. What's worse, there are other rumors saying that they are being led by a human.{/}

Ruins of Detlas#011.src: What madman would turn against their own kind in favor of... those things?
Ruins of Detlas#011.dst: {c1}一体どんな狂人が、同族を裏切って……あの化け物たちの味方になるというのか？{/}
Ruins of Detlas#011.note: {c1}What madman would turn against their own kind in favor of... those things?{/}

Ruins of Detlas#012.src: I just hope I can keep my people safe. Wait, I fear something approaches..
Ruins of Detlas#012.dst: {c1}ただ、仲間たちを無事に守れることを願うばかりだ。待て、何かが近づいてくる気がする……{/}
Ruins of Detlas#012.note: {c1}I just hope I can keep my people safe. Wait, I fear something approaches..{/}

Ruins of Detlas#013.src: The book is torn in half. The rest of the entry must be somewhere nearby...
Ruins of Detlas#013.dst: {c1}その本は半分に破れている。残りの記述は、きっとこの近くのどこかにあるに違いない……{/}
Ruins of Detlas#013.note: {c1}The book is torn in half. The rest of the entry must be somewhere nearby...{/}

Ruins of Detlas#014.src: The pages are torn and are black with soot on the edges. You read the rest of the entry...
Ruins of Detlas#014.dst: {c1}ページは破れており、端は煤で真っ黒になっている。あなたは残りの記述を読み進めた……{/}
Ruins of Detlas#014.note: {c1}The pages are torn and are black with soot on the edges. You read the rest of the entry...{/}

Ruins of Detlas#015.src: This may be my final entry. The human leading the horde is no human. He is tainted. Broken. Controlled.
Ruins of Detlas#015.dst: {c1}これが最後の投稿になるかもしれない。群れを率いているその人間は、もはや人間ではない。彼は穢れに染まり、壊れ、操られているのだ。{/}
Ruins of Detlas#015.note: {c1}This may be my final entry. The human leading the horde is no human. He is tainted. Broken. Controlled.{/}

Ruins of Detlas#016.src: Fire spreads from his hands like magic.. If only we had such power. Someone has to stop this. Alas, it can not be me. He is here.
Ruins of Detlas#016.dst: {c1}まるで魔法のように、彼の手から炎が広がっていく……。私たちにもそんな力があればいいのに。誰かがこれを止めなければならない。ああ、残念ながら、それは私ではできない。彼がここにいる。{/}
Ruins of Detlas#016.note: {c1}Fire spreads from his hands like magic.. If only we had such power. Someone has to stop this. Alas, it can not be me. He is here.{/}

Ruins of Detlas#017.src: I was talking to Mary the other day. She said some of the survivors are planning to make the trip to {p} or {p}.
Ruins of Detlas#017.dst: {c1}先日、 Mary と話していた=。彼女によると、生存者たちの中には、{p}か{p}へ旅行に行く計画を立てている人もいるそうだ。{/}
Ruins of Detlas#017.note: {c1}I was talking to Mary the other day. She said some of the survivors are planning to make the trip to {p} or {p}.{/}

Ruins of Detlas#018.src: She asked me if we should go with them. I told her we we're staying here. The road to {p} is too dangerous, and {p} is too far away.
Ruins of Detlas#018.dst: {c1}彼女は、私たちも彼らと一緒にいくべきかと尋ねてきた。私は、ここにとどまるつもりだと答えた。{p}への道は危険すぎるし、{p}は遠すぎるからだ。{/}
Ruins of Detlas#018.note: {c1}She asked me if we should go with them. I told her we we're staying here. The road to {p} is too dangerous, and {p} is too far away.{/}

Ruins of Detlas#019.src: But as the night draws near, I'm not sure about my decision...
Ruins of Detlas#019.dst: {c1}でも、夜が近づいてくると、自分の決断に自信がなくなってきて……{/}
Ruins of Detlas#019.note: {c1}But as the night draws near, I'm not sure about my decision...{/}

Ruins of Detlas#020.src: This journal is opened to an entry dated {~} AP. You begin to read it...
Ruins of Detlas#020.dst: {c1}この日記は、{~} APの日付のページが開かれている。あなたはそれを読み始める……{/}
Ruins of Detlas#020.note: {c1}This journal is opened to an entry dated {~} AP. You begin to read it...{/}

Ruins of Detlas#021.src: There aren't that many left in this town. If this place can even be called a town.
Ruins of Detlas#021.dst: {c1}この町には、もうそれほど多くは残っていない。そもそも、ここを「町」と呼べるかどうかは別として。{/}
Ruins of Detlas#021.note: {c1}There aren't that many left in this town. If this place can even be called a town.{/}

Ruins of Detlas#022.src: There's me, Hank, Mary, their kids, the Mayor who's crazy now, Andy, Steve, and Judy and her kids.
Ruins of Detlas#022.dst: {c1}私、 Hank 、 Mary 、その子供たち、今は頭がおかしくなってしまった市長、 Andy 、 Steve 、そして Judy とその子供たちだ。{/}
Ruins of Detlas#022.note: {c1}There's me, Hank, Mary, their kids, the Mayor who's crazy now, Andy, Steve, and Judy and her kids.{/}

Ruins of Detlas#023.src: We only have enough for about a day or so. We have no choice: we need to leave for a fortress.
Ruins of Detlas#023.dst: {c1}手持ちの食料はあと1日分くらいしかない。仕方ない。要塞へ向かわなければならない。{/}
Ruins of Detlas#023.note: {c1}We only have enough for about a day or so. We have no choice: we need to leave for a fortress.{/}

Ruins of Detlas#024.src: Andy, Steve, and I will lead. The road to {p} is difficult. If you read this, I hope {p} still stands.
Ruins of Detlas#024.dst: {c1}Andy 、 Steve 、そして私が先頭を切る。{p}への道のりは険しい。これを読んでいるなら、{p}がまだ健在であることを願っている。{/}
Ruins of Detlas#024.note: {c1}Andy, Steve, and I will lead. The road to {p} is difficult. If you read this, I hope {p} still stands.{/}
